Package org.geysermc.paletter.item

Record Class CustomItem

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.item.CustomItem
Record Components:
identifier - the item identifier, e.g. geysermc:furnace_minecart (description identifier)
components - the components (one per component name), in the order they were added
menuCategory - the description's menu_category, or null: then it follows creative() (and without one, Bedrock's default)
creative - where it goes in the creative inventory, or null to leave it out
public record CustomItem(@NonNull String identifier, @NonNull List<ItemComponent> components, @Nullable MenuCategory menuCategory, @Nullable CreativePlacement creative) extends Record
A custom (data driven) item: an add-on JSON minecraft:item in Java. The palette assigns its runtime id and canonical id, compiles its components to the item component data of each palette's protocol, and places it in the creative inventory. 

 CustomItem ruby = CustomItem.builder("example:ruby")
     .component(Icon.of("ruby"))
     .component(MaxStackSize.of(16))
     .component(Durability.builder().maxDurability(250).build())
     .creative(CreativePlacement.group(CreativeCategory.ITEMS, "itemGroup.name.minerals"))
     .build();
Since:
1.0.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
